capital.name: Tokyo
capital.shortDescription: A vast, fast-moving capital where precision, pop culture, craft, and quiet ritual coexist.

prompts.prompt: Which country is associated with manga, sushi, and Mount Fuji?
Ramen, sushi, and matcha are strongly associated with which country?
Mount Fuji is one of the most recognizable symbols of which country?

reveal.intro: Japan can feel precise, playful, quiet, and overwhelming all at once. Ritual and pop culture, neighborhood intimacy and world-making imagination all sit side by side.

heroImage.alt: Tokyo skyline with lights and urban density

funFacts: Japan is made up of thousands of islands, though most of the population lives on four main ones.
Its design traditions stretch from centuries-old craft to contemporary visual worlds that shape global taste.
Seasonal attention, from cherry blossoms to autumn leaves, is not just scenic but built into everyday rhythms.

items.name: Onigiri
items.description: Rice shaped by hand into a portable, comforting everyday food that can be simple, perfect, and oddly moving in its restraint.
items.whyItMatters: Onigiri says something essential about Japanese everyday life: practicality, care, detail, and quiet pleasure.

items.name: Haruomi Hosono
items.description: A foundational figure in Japanese popular music whose work feels playful, sophisticated, and still startlingly fresh.

items.name: Hikaru Utada
items.description: A defining modern artist whose work bridges pop, introspection, and cross-generational appeal.

items.name: Kitchen
items.creator: Banana Yoshimoto
items.description: A tender, lucid novel that makes ordinary interiors, grief, appetite, and closeness feel quietly luminous.

items.name: Naoshima
items.description: A small island known for contemporary art, architecture, and a way of making landscape, museums, and design feel like one continuous experience.
items.whyItMatters: It offers a less default image of Japan and makes the country's relationship to art, place, and design feel unusually tangible.

items.name: Yayoi Kusama
items.description: A globally influential artist whose installations turn repetition, color, and obsession into unforgettable visual worlds.

items.name: Tokyo
items.description: Tokyo moves between neon intensity and quiet ritual, with neighborhoods that can feel futuristic, fashionable, traditional, or deeply local from one train stop to the next.
